missions.title: Stone & Salt
missions.intro: Pastor Josephs: "Welcome to Rocklands. Before you go making friends, see our quarry from the lookout, and greet Auntie Gail at the fish shop. She knows everyone."

objectives.text: Look over the old quarry from the lookout

missions.title: The Long Haul
missions.intro: Auntie Gail: "Uncle Solly in Lentegeur ordered snoek for his birthday braai. It's three districts away and it won't stay fresh. Take a car if you have one!"
missions.description: Deliver fresh fish across all three districts.
missions.fail_text: The snoek turned. Auntie Gail sends a sorry message to Solly.

objectives.text: Deliver the snoek to Uncle Solly (Lentegeur)
Tell Auntie Gail it arrived fresh (Rocklands)

missions.title: Quarry Night
missions.intro: Pastor Josephs: "The Rock Royals chase families off the lookout at night. Talk to Klip, then stand there with your crew. Peacefully."
missions.description: Open the lookout to everyone again.

objectives.text: Talk to Klip at the Rock Royals' house (Spine Road)
Hold the quarry lookout with your crew after dark

intro_by_crew.klipspringers: Pastor Josephs: "You're one of Klip's now, I hear. Then ask him to open the lookout to families at night, and stand there with your crew so it's seen to be peaceful."
